name: Nonoshita Yuuna
source:
The heroine. "Mamahaha." She has a kind and loving personality.

She loves children, and dotes on Tomoki as if he were her own child. She helps out Tomoki, who has wet dreams.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc087/index.html#character]official site[/url]]
